caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing female figure placed atop a dark green, four-sided, stepped pedestal equipped with two visible wheels on the left side. The figure is dressed in a green, sleeveless, classical-style robe gathered at the waist, with a reddish-purple and gold-trimmed cloth draped over her right arm and falling along her right side. A golden or yellowish shawl or cloak hangs over her shoulders and down her back. The figure's skin is a warm brown tone, and she wears a wreath of purple and brown leaves or feathers on her head, with her dark brown hair tied back. Her right arm is bent slightly at the elbow, holding a round object in her hand, while her left arm extends downward, grasping the edge of the draped cloth. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional elements.
